<thought>Analyzing the observed isotopic envelope, the clear decreasing series of peaks (M, M+1 ≈ 17 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1.6 % of M, etc.) matches the expected binomial distribution from many ¹³C atoms in an organic molecule. No characteristic 2:1 (Cl) or 1:1 (Br) patterns are present, and the smaller contributions from S, O, N are below the detection threshold. Therefore, carbon is the only element whose isotopic pattern can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
